inspections.title: Food stored or prepared unsafely
inspections.detail: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.title: Infection control not followed
inspections.detail: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

inspections.title: Resident dignity not respected
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.

inspections.title: Unnecessary psychiatric drugs (sedating medications)
inspections.detail: Prevent the use of unnecessary psychotropic medications or use medications that may restrain a resident's ability to function.

inspections.title: Transfer / bed-hold notice not given
inspections.detail: Provide the required documentation or notification related to the resident's needs, appeal rights, or bed-hold policies.

inspections.detail: Ensure each resident’s drug regimen must be free from unnecessary drugs.

inspections.title: Accident hazards or not enough supervision (falls, wandering)
inspections.detail: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.

inspections.detail: Protect each resident from all types of abuse such as physical, mental, sexual abuse, physical punishment, and neglect by anybody.

inspections.detail: Ensure nurse aides have the skills they need to care for residents, and give nurse aides education in dementia care and abuse prevention.

inspections.detail: Timely report suspected abuse, neglect, or theft and report the results of the investigation to proper authorities.

inspections.title: Care plan incomplete
inspections.detail: Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.

inspections.title: Ensure necessary information is communicated to the resident, and receiving health care provider at the time of a planned discharge
inspections.detail: Ensure necessary information is communicated to the resident, and receiving health care provider at the time of a planned discharge.

inspections.title: Bed rails used without safety checks
inspections.detail: Try different approaches before using a bed rail.  If a bed rail is needed, the facility must (1) assess a resident for safety risk; (2) review these risks and benefits with the resident/representative; (3) get informed consent; and (4) Correctly install and maintain the bed rail.

inspections.title: Psychiatric drugs not reduced or reviewed as required
inspections.detail: Implement gradual dose reductions(GDR) and non-pharmacological interventions, unless contraindicated, prior to initiating or instead of continuing psychotropic medication; and PRN orders for psychotropic medications are only used when the medication is necessary and PRN use is limited.
